summary: Planning-only split of I01f1 into two pending same-B1 children: owned Windows/WSL ADB/Appium/AVD lifecycle with actual one-device service readiness/failure/cleanup qualification, then normal-APK install/startup capture and measured device-to-real-Compose public/source routing. I01f1 stays in-progress with its original outcome and all three checks unchanged for combined parent qualification. Read-only inventory reconfirms Windows WHPX/API29 definitions, no Linux KVM, an unrelated live ADB5037 server, closed dedicated5038 and Appium absent from PATH. No runtime/build/controller/UI input changed or service/device started; no acceptance, review or release gate passed.
selectionReason: Clean master matches the supplied startCommit, D-304 explicitly authorizes application implementation, findings are empty and B1 review is not yet due. I01f1 is the actual earliest eligible task with I01a/I01c/I01d/I01e implemented. Its three original checks combine a reusable cross-host resource-ownership controller with actual normal-APK installation/evidence and Docker-to-Android network integration. The fresh inventory confirms this is not an ordinary Linux emulator setup: Linux has no KVM, Windows WHPX is usable, default ADB5037 is already somebody else's listener, and the isolated Appium executable/driver installation must be explicitly qualified. Split before coding so a bounded lifecycle unit establishes tested ownership/readiness/cleanup before a fresh integration unit handles APK and real Compose routes. No priority is skipped, parent obligation narrowed or per-child independent review added.

coverage: I01f1a owns the lifecycle and test-only service boundary, not account/game behavior. Require explicit executable and isolated driver home rather than PATH fallback or reuse of the unowned default ADB server. Dedicated loopback ADB/Appium, AVD/serial/console/system-port allocation and exact process-start ownership precede launch; collision/foreign-identity/readiness failures cannot produce a usable handoff. Retain detached Windows launch, boot-completed plus actual package-manager and Appium status checks, and Windows-native emulator shutdown.

I01f1a must execute actual lifecycle/failure/cleanup checks under the existing permissions, not just mock controller tests. Diagnostics precede cleanup and exact owned services stop while unrelated devices/listeners survive. No hypervisor, global networking, permission or authorization changes; an unavailable prerequisite remains visible and D-305 troubleshooting applies. The denied external historical smoke archive was not consulted or accessed through a fallback; repository topology records and fresh allowed inventory supply planning evidence.

I01f1b handles the normal scaffold APK without an alternate test activity, test button or injected game/account records. Capture the real MainActivity's branded visible native startup/hierarchy with exact APK/package/signer/API identity and read-only storage-startup diagnostics. This is startup qualification only; I01f2 still owns Kotlin/Appium scenario execution and all 14 actual production-driver/controller/launcher instrumentation tests.

I01f1b measures the cross-host device route rather than assuming Windows ADB reverse can reach Linux loopback. Only the I01e environment's public backend/source loopback endpoints may be mapped/forwarded, preserving synthetic source art origins; private health/admin/mailbox/reset/DB/SMTP stays unexposed. Backend public 404 is currently expected, while synthetic metadata/catalog/art hashes establish meaningful actual source transport. No wildcard listener, production TLS-trust relaxation or normal downloader/auth acceptance claim.

Routing failure and foreign/busy mappings must fail setup without replacing another owner's routes or leaving stale success. Retain actual failure evidence and fresh successful recovery, safe captures and exact mapping/device/service/Compose cleanup. I01f1b documents the handoff consumed by I01f2. I01f2/I01f3 retain independent-scenario fresh app data versus in-scenario process-restart retention, simultaneous two/three sessions, cold-boot/reset repeat and per-device instrumentation.

Original I01f1 outcome and all three checks remain verbatim; I01f and I01 parent outcomes/checks remain verbatim too. Current/tablet/non-GMS compatibility, physical frame evidence, mixed-version/signed upgrade, arm64 and external release readiness remain I33/I35/operator obligations without waivers. No requirement/scenario/feedback item is marked executed by this planning/inventory unit.
